parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe, typically made of plastic, representing the Earth with printed or textured continents and oceans.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main display surface showing the Earth's geography. It can rotate around its axis to simulate Earth's rotation.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates smoothly around a tilted axis supported by the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base and supporting frame of the globe, made of plastic, providing stability and holding the rotating sphere in place.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the globe sphere and allows it to rotate freely while maintaining balance on a flat surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a pivot axis for the sphere’s rotation.
